title: Lumen Prize

title: Jan van Eyck Academie residency

title: Pioneer Works residencies
summary: Residencies in art, science, music and technology in Brooklyn.

title: Canada Council for the Arts grants
summary: Grants for Canadian artists and arts organisations.

summary: Grants for individual creative practitioners based in England.

title: DAAD scholarships

title: Charles Wallace India Trust awards

title: Aesthetica Art Prize
summary: Annual international prize run by Aesthetica Magazine, including digital and moving-image work. Entry fees apply.

title: NLnet open call
summary: Grants for open-source and open-standards technical work, with rounds every few months. EU-backed funds usually expect Horizon Europe-eligible applicants.

title: QUANTUM: Through Your Eyes photography call

title: Kala Media Arts Artist-in-Residence and Exhibition Award
summary: Fellowship for film, video, sound, animation and installation artists with studio access for up to nine months and a group show. Applications open 1 January 2027.

title: Thessaloniki Documentary Festival 2027: Immersive / XR competition

title: Epic MegaGrants
summary: Rolling grants from Epic Games for projects that use or improve Unreal Engine, including art, education and tools.

title: ISEA call for papers and artworks
summary: Annual calls for papers, artworks and workshops for the International Symposium on Electronic Art; host city and dates change each year.

title: xCoAx call for papers and artworks
summary: Annual call for the conference on Computation, Communication, Aesthetics and X.

title: Generative Art Conference call
summary: Annual call for papers, artworks and performances for the Generative Art conference.

title: CERN Arts Collide residency
summary: Residency programme pairing an artist with CERN scientists; check the current call for eligibility and dates.

title: LACMA Art + Technology Lab grants
summary: Grants and in-kind support for artists developing projects with emerging technology; check the current call for eligibility.

title: Gray Area Incubator
summary: Residency and incubator programme for artists working at the intersection of art, technology and social impact.

title: ONX Studio membership
summary: Onassis and New Museum’s New York programme supporting artists working in XR and digital media.

title: Creative Industries Fund NL grants
summary: Dutch public fund supporting design, architecture and digital culture, mainly for makers based in the Netherlands.

title: Creative Australia grants
summary: Australian Government arts funding body; grants for Australian artists and organisations.

summary: Recurring call for light-art proposals for Singapore’s sustainable light festival in Marina Bay; check the current edition’s dates.
